purpose: Unweighted finite-sample projections of one released cleaned-number table; same three analyses for generated releases

input.numeric_dtype: real numeric, not bool/complex; canonical missing only
input.extra_columns: ignored by analysis; generated-context guard requires exact id,age,sex,bmi,glucose

measured_reference.age_definition: census age on 31 July2014 at sample selection
measured_reference.native_and_tagged_missing: exclude before numerical use; no imputation
measured_reference.sentinel_scope: None documented in reviewed codebook definitions/actual variable metadata; not proof none exists. No inferred sentinel from extremes.
measured_reference.recorded_boundary_values: retain finite positive cleaned numbers; assay/censoring limitation remains
measured_reference.weighting: none; not a national or design-based parameter

eligibility.reference_ineligible_rows: exclude with fixed overlapping reason counts
eligibility.generated_ineligible_rows: reject whole table, never filter or repair
eligibility.reference_final_n: determined only after frozen custody release; never constructor input

design.centering: fixed numerical coordinates, not scientific source or target parameters
design.rank_tolerance: max(n,p)*float64_epsilon*largest_singular_value; all three unavailable if either rank fails

estimands.meaning: Female-minus-Male difference in BMI contrast under common age adjustment

evidence_status.reuse_item: K01-SEX-BMI within three primaries, not extra fourth endpoint

uncertainty.reference_only: HC3 sandwich with1.959963984540054 normal multiplier, working descriptive sensitivity
uncertainty.generated: no inferential interval from synthetic rows
uncertainty.point_vs_interval: finite identifiable point may remain when residual variation/HC3 unavailable

failures.unavailable_reference: case cannot pass; retain failure without selecting substitute outcomes

comparison.nonpositive_or_nonfinite_SD: normalized endpoint unavailable and cannot pass
comparison.meaning: author-selected exploratory resolution, not percent error or biomedical equivalence
comparison.directions: report alongside magnitudes, not sole success criterion

bundle.constructor_pass: all3estimands within fixed working resolution on all3seeds; any failed/missing output fails
bundle.case_reliability_pass: at least4ofall5Agentconstructors; failed attempts stay denominator
bundle.zero_anchor: zero for each of3effect contrasts; if all3zeroanchors withinworkingresolution, case cannot alone support joint-signal recovery or positiveWaveB
bundle.retention: final aliasesinitial; zero revision gain; no additional draw
bundle.independent_evidence_units: cases/studies and constructions, not rows or seeds
